name: Thai curry noodle soup
assumptions: Yield estimated from instructions that divide the finished soup between two bowls.
Total active and cooking time summed from the two steps (1 min + 3 min + 5 min plus negligible bring-to-boil time) rounded to nearest 10 min.
Pescatarian true because the only animal product is shellfish (prawns).
Vegetarian and Vegan false because of prawns.
Dairy-free true; no milk or dairy ingredients listed.
Gluten-free null because udon noodles are typically wheat-based but could be certified gluten-free in some products; not specified here.
Shellfish true because of Raw King Prawns.
Wheat true because of Udon Noodles (wheat flour).
Thai Green Curry Paste left as null for all allergens because it is a compound ingredient whose exact formulation is unspecified.
No other allergens confidently present or absent.
instructions:
step 1
Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and cook the curry paste for 1 min before adding the stir-fry veg and prawns. Cook for 3 mins until the prawns are mostly pink, then add the coconut milk, veg stock and noodles.

step 2
Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 5 mins until the noodles are cooked through and the veg is tender but still has a bite. Divide between two bowls and sprinkle over the herbs, chilli and spring onion.

ingredients.name: Thai Green Curry Paste
ingredients.assumptions: Typical Thai green curry paste nutrition; 1 tbsp ≈ 15g.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry Vegetables
ingredients.assumptions: Mixed stir-fry vegetables (broccoli, peppers, carrots, etc.); given as 220g, used directly.

ingredients.name: Raw King Prawns
ingredients.assumptions: Raw king prawns, peeled; given as 150g, used directly (edible portion).

ingredients.name: Vegetable Stock
ingredients.assumptions: Vegetable stock/broth from concentrate or cube; 225ml ≈ 225g, low-calorie.

ingredients.name: Udon Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Pre-cooked udon noodles (typical vacuum-packed); given as 250g, used directly.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh coriander (cilantro) leaves; given as 10g, used directly.

ingredients.name: Basil
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh basil leaves; given as 10g, used directly.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red chilli, sliced (edible portion ≈20g including seeds).
